summary: Defines an LDAP schema, meaning object classes and attributes, for describing printers and printer services in a directory. It is based on the printer attributes listed in the Internet Printing Protocol and on the Printer MIB. It is informational and was replaced by RFC 7612.

eli5.summary: A school keeps a phone book of people. This adds a page for printers, with fields like what each can do, so computers can look one up.

questions: how to describe printers in ldap
